text_blocks.snippet: Pfizer's main drug for treating COVID-19 is Paxlovid, an oral antiviral pill. It's designed to be taken at home by individuals at high risk for severe illness from COVID-19, within the first five days of symptom onset. The FDA has granted full approval for adults with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 at high risk of severe disease, hospitalization, and death, according to Yale Medicine. Initially, it was authorized for emergency use for those 12 and older who weigh at least 88 pounds. The medication is now transitioning from government distribution to commercial availability.
